The 2D hand on the whole arsenal (F4, D52)

SDAX · SDTT/SDTF · SDIZ/SDIF · SDPP/SDPF · SDRL/SDRF · SDRK/SDKF · SDHK/SDHF · 20 held + 11 flash frames · draft · 2026-10-14_1200

D52 (“Manos 1”): the sergeant's hand drawn in 2D pixel art, style E (brown leather glove, field sleeve, telnyashka), now on every weapon, with every held and flash frame its state machine shows (read from src/zscript/weapons/*.zs, never edited). The weapons are gen_weapon's own 3D renders without their hand; the hand is drawn per frame on each grip. Animation reference: Blood (D49), style only, nothing of Blood copied. Every frame is numbered (AX-1, TT-1, …; the flash frames TF-1, …) and shown at 2x and 1x over MAP01 as GZDoom drew it (the dorm, rebuilt without its weapon from six engine captures of the same view; the capture's own status bar on top). Positions follow Doom's arithmetic and are NOT VERIFIED in GZDoom (D26): the engine pass is the PM's. Sprites: work/art/weapons_2d/<weapon>/, final names (MOD-SPEC §6.3) with grAb, ready for the draft overlay. Nothing is in assets/; the installed pickups are untouched.

Self-assessment

The wrist turns. Each frame has its own drawing on the grip, chosen by hand: AX-1 the back of the fist (as approved), AX-2 the fist seen from its fingers with the thumb across them (the wrist cocked back over the shoulder), AX-3 rolled over, the folded fingers and the knuckles to the eye, AX-4 the back of the hand to the eye with the fingers wrapped away (the wrist flexed into the blow), AX-5 nearly back to rest. Played at game speed (B-C-D-C-B, as ice_axe.zs swings) the fist visibly turns over instead of one fist being skewed, which was the 11:05 trial's flaw.

Weak. AX-3 to AX-5 are still the one back-of-fist drawing turned and foreshortened, not drawn from scratch as AX-2 is; at 1x the turn reads mostly through the knuckles and the forearm's angle. AX-4, the pick going in, shows the least hand (about 1 500 px above the status bar). AX-5 (SDAXE0) is drawn because MOD-SPEC reserves A-E, but ice_axe.zs never shows it today.

Self-assessment

The hand is in shot now. The pose is the approved one raised 4 cm and moved 1 cm left (D52, the 11:05 TT-1R): the glove, three folded fingers, the index on the trigger, the cuff and the telnyashka all read at 1x, as Doom's own pistol frames a hand. The kick is exaggerated after Blood: on TT-2 the slide goes back and the muzzle climbs, on TT-3 the pistol and hand ride up about 25 px; TF-1 sits on TT-2's muzzle.

Weak. One hand only (Doom's grammar, not Blood's two-handed one). The pistol is small, so the glove is half the sprite and the folded fingers read as stacked bars rather than as fingers wrapped round a grip. The serrations and the star medallion stay one or two pixels at 1x.

As approved, with the 2D hand. The left hand under the fore-end is the hand you see; it sits 4 cm further out than the 3D one so more of it clears the status bar, and through the reload (IZ-4 broken open, IZ-3, IZ-2) it slides out along the barrels: the off hand moves, as in Blood. The PPSh treatment (the gun moved in and up) would bring the right hand in, but the IZh's pose is approved and D52 names only the TT-33 and the PPSh: a proposal for the CEO, not done here.

Self-assessment

Both hands in shot. The gun is moved 5 cm left, 4 cm up and 8 cm forward (D52): the left hand wraps the fore-end ahead of the drum, the right hand grips the stock's wrist with the index on the trigger, and the muzzle stays under and left of the crosshair. Two frames, as ppsh.zs alternates them; PF-1 is the one flash both rounds show (the state machine has only CHGF A), so on PP-2 it sits a few px off the kicked-back muzzle, as it will in the engine.

Weak. The right glove lies on the birch stock, and both are slices of the same rust-brown ramp: the hand separates from the wood only by its dark outline, the lowest contrast in the arsenal. Fixing it means a darker glove or a different wood, and both are approved materials, so it is left for the CEO's eye.

A hand where there was none. In the approved pose the left hand sat under the screen's edge (the 3D frames showed a sliver, the 2D ones nothing). It is brought 12 cm along the tube, re-projected (smaller as it goes further), so a gloved fist holds the tube on RL-1 and RL-2. RF-1 to RF-4 are gen_weapon's blast and smoke at the muzzle.

Weak, the weakest of the set. The tube recedes straight into the middle of the screen, small, the right hand is on the grip behind the eye, and only one fist shows (300 to 800 px above the bar). Against Blood this is the frame that most needs a new pose: the launcher lower and turned across the view so both hands and the warhead read. The pose is approved, so that is a proposal for the CEO, not done here.

Self-assessment

Variant B with both hands (D51, D49). Six bare tubes in riveted bands carried low at the hip, the right hand on the pistol grip with the index on the trigger, the left on the forward handle, both sleeves running out to the corners. HK-2 is the salvo with the exaggerated kick; HF-1 lights the six motors and the backblast, HF-2 is their smoke. The hands are drawn at the 5 px/cm floor while the launcher sits at about 3.4 px/cm, so they are half again life size: Blood's big hands, on purpose.

Weak. That scale is a judgement call; if the CEO finds the gloves too big for the launcher, it is one number (Arm.min_px). HK-2's sprite is 384 px wide, the forearms reaching both edges of the screen: fine in the 320 columns, to be checked in widescreen in the engine. The pickup (SDHPA0, variant B) is gen_weapon's own render, copied into the folder so the overlay finds a complete set.

The whole arsenal: self-assessment

3D weapon and 2D hand together. At 1x they sit well: same palette ramps, same key light, a dark outline on both. At 2x the difference shows: the hand is four flat bands with creases, the weapon six bands with soft contours. Item 6 of the brief is applied lightly: every held frame's weapon gets the hand's hard silhouette (its outer pixels three ramp steps darker, WEAPON_RIM_STEPS), in the 2D frames only; the installed pickups and every PNG in work/art/weapons/ are untouched. The effect is small, because the 3D render already darkened its rim; the honest remaining gap is the banding, which would mean re-lighting the approved weapons.

What is not done. Nothing has been seen in GZDoom (D26): positions follow Doom's arithmetic. The animations are built from the .zs state lines (tics, A_GunFlash, A_ReFire, the IZh's reload) at 35 tics a second, without the weapon bob. Poses changed only where D52 says (TT-33, PPSh-41); the RPG-7 and the IZh-58 would gain most from Blood-style poses next, and that needs the CEO.
